verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a CLI is a community comment saying sign-up was possible only via the CLI (stagewise-comm-11), which implies an official CLI existed at some point. Current first-party docs describe a downloadable desktop IDE (stagewise-docs-24) with in-app agent shell access, and never document a stagewise CLI. Missing for 10: first-party CLI documentation, install/usage instructions, evidence of agent or workflow commands via the CLI, and confirmation that the CLI is current rather than legacy.
